author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a front-view car (rounded body, windscreen cabin, wheel stubs) under three equal parallel diagonal spray streaks, as the reviewer asked; car symmetric about x=24, even pitch between the streaks.
omissions: Per the reviewer, the source's wash bubbles (dots and small rings) became three diagonal streaks. The headlight lines were dropped because the 8-unit body leaves no clearance for them.
drawing_plan: Lucide car-front body, cabin and wheel stubs on x=24; three diagonal spray lines on a 10-unit pitch above the roof.
